”) announced on 29 September 2026 that the Company’s Extraordinary General Meeting has approved the Board of Directors’ proposals to combine the share series and to authorise the Board of Directors to decide on a directed share issue against consideration. Martela announced earlier today that, based on the authorisation, it is commencing a directed share issue against consideration of approximately EUR 6-8 million in which it will initially offer for subscription a maximum of 17,777,777 new shares of the Company corresponding to the existing series A shares, representing the Company’s sole series of shares following the combination of share series (the “
”) in deviation from the shareholders’ pre-emptive subscription right (the “
”). The subscription price is EUR 0.45 per Offer Share.

In connection with the Share Issue, the combination of share series and the related directed share issue without consideration, and for the purpose of applying for the new shares issued herein to be admitted to trading on a regulated market, the Company has prepared a Finnish-language exemption document pursuant to Article 1(4)(db) and Article 1(5)(ba) of Regulation (EU) 2017/1129 of the European Parliament and of the Council (the “
”). The Exemption Document has been prepared in accordance with the requirements of Annex IX to the Prospectus Regulation.

The Exemption Document is available on the Company’s website at https://www.martela.com/fi/tietoa-meista/martela-yrityksena/sijoittajille/suunnattu-osakeanti as of approximately 30 September 2026 and before the commencement of the subscription period. In addition, the Exemption Document is available on the Lead Manager’s website at https://www.alexander.fi/osakeannit/martela/ as of approximately 30 September 2026 and before the commencement of the subscription period.
The subscription period of the Share Issue commences on 30 September 2026 at 12:00 p.m. (EEST) and expires on 5 October 2026 at 10:00 a.m. (EEST).
Aktia Alexander Corporate Finance Oy is acting as Martela’s financial advisor and Lead Manager of the Share Issue. Castrén & Snellman Attorneys Ltd is acting as Martela’s legal advisor.
Chairman of the Board, Tapio Pajuharju
NASDAQ Helsinki, key news media, www.martela.com

Martela is a Nordic leader specialising in user-centric working and learning environments. With over 80 years of experience, we create the best places to work and offer our customers the Martela Lifecycle solutions which combine furniture and related services into a seamless whole.
